analysis.commands: s 0x004A23D0; af-*; af @ 0x004C4820; af @ 0x004A23D0; afij; afbj
analysis.note: radare2 default analysis follows the tail jump into 0x004C4820; the recorded graph is the honest thunk after carving the callee as its own function.

limitations: radare2 edge kinds are derived from the afbj jump/fail fields: a conditional block contributes its jump and its fail edge as the two conditional outcomes.
radare2 does not recover types; the signature is its best-effort calling-convention sketch.
